events.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Manu Koné (Roma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Roma. Niccolò Pisilli replaces Manu Koné because of an injury.
Goal! Roma 1, Real Madrid 0. Marten de Roon (Roma) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Matías Soulé.
Goal! Roma 1, Real Madrid 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Yan Diomande with a headed pass.
Delay in match (Roma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Roma 1, Real Madrid 1.
Substitution, Roma. Rodrigo Mora replaces Paulo Dybala.
Goal! Roma 2, Real Madrid 1. Donyell Malen (Roma) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Rodrigo Mora.

Goal! Roma 3, Real Madrid 1. Donyell Malen (Roma) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Matías Soulé with a through ball following a fast break.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Endrick replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Arda Güler replaces Denzel Dumfries.
Gianluca Mancini (Roma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Roma. Lorenzo Pellegrini replaces Matías Soulé.
Substitution, Roma. Leonardo Balerdi replaces Gianluca Mancini.
Wesley (Roma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Bernardo Silva replaces Aurélien Tchouaméni.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Álvaro Carreras replaces Marc Cucurella.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Yan Diomande.
Substitution, Roma. Konstantinos Koulierakis replaces Mario Hermoso.
Goal! Roma 3, Real Madrid 2. Carlos Espí (Real Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a corner.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Goal! Roma 3, Real Madrid 3. Endrick (Real Madrid) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Arda Güler with a cross following a corner.
Lorenzo Pellegrini (Roma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Roma 3, Real Madrid 4. Antonio Rüdiger (Real Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Arda Güler with a cross following a corner.
Álvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
